method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed building frame. No flattening. 8-meter grid uses standard z14 Terrarium. Cliffs and crest edges can be smoothed by the sample spacing. The terrain descriptor references the modeled crest datum. Stored heights and the PNG quantization are preserved.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed urban foundation levels. Vegetation and urban surface returns can affect the field.
